title: Data Landscapers frontmatter
description: The frontmatter schemas of the wiki/ specs (facets.md §1, layout.md §3, schemas.md §4–5) and finance-record-spec.md, machine-readable. Authored against BOTH the prose specs and the live corpus: every `required` key below is carried by 100% of the files of that type today, so the schema describes the vault as it is, not as a document once said it should be. Where the two disagreed the disagreement is recorded in the key's own description. `x-` members are this vault's extensions and are ignored by a standard validator; scripts/lint-deterministic.py reads them.

date.description: A full ISO date. Padded per §3 where precision is coarser, with the truth kept in date_precision.

publishedDate.description: §3 pads a partial date in the FILENAME; a handful of sources keep the unpadded truth in `published` itself (`2021-09`). Both forms are admissible here — date_precision is what carries the claim.

placeCode.description: ISO-3 country code or X__ region code. §1: reject values outside the vocabulary; a genuinely new value is Bill's call, not lint's.

topic.description: Level-2 taxonomy slug, never the label. §1: `topics` is ORDERED and the order is load-bearing — the first non-finance.* slug is the primary subject. Never sort this list.

slug.description: An entity-page slug: lower-case kebab, no path, no extension.

linkList.description: Written `[[a], [b]]` — one bracket layer per item (§1). The pairing means a body-wikilink regex matches none of it; lint #12 polices the form.

source.x-url-blank-note: A blank url: is admissible ONLY with url_note: stating dated evidence the search was exhausted (schemas.md §5a). minLength was dropped for that case; a blank with no url_note is still a defect and lint #14 is what says so.
source.x-expected-note: `ingested` is carried by every source in raw/ and by none of the budget-archive companions, which were archived rather than ingested. A real convention, not worth a defect, so it reports softly. (`lens` sat here too until 2026-09-08, when the facet was retired: schemas.md §4. It is written by nothing and is no longer a property of any type. The 17,036 legacy values were cleared on 2026-09-20 in two passes — 15,372 in raw/ and 1,696 everywhere else — so the key is now in git history only and an unknown-key hit means something has started writing it again.)

x-filename.note: §3: every source in raw/ carries its true publication date as a prefix, and the prefix names the shard — raw/YYYY/ must equal the first four characters of the filename.

url.description: The document-specific URL. A bare domain cites nothing and breaks the dedup key (lint #14) — except on a standing-object capture of an organisation's own site, where it IS the document.

date_source.description: §3 documents `source` and `proxy` (the date fell back to ingested/created). `inferred` (83, all budget-archive companions — a fiscal year read off the document) and `derived` (4) are in use and carry a distinct meaning, so they are admitted here rather than rewritten. `proxy` on a finance record is forbidden outright by finance-record-spec.md → Dates and is lint #21's class 1.

body_completeness.description: §4: missing means UNVERIFIED and blank asserts nothing — `full` is never assumed of a legacy source. A structured extract of a tabular document, a journal abstract with its citation, and anything the wiki generated rather than captured are `excerpt` and STAY `excerpt`; they are complete records, not defects awaiting repair.

catalogue_hero.description: §4: the record's subtitle in the public catalogue. Required on every source ingested from 2026-09-05; earlier sources carry none and are the backfill lane, which is why it is not in `required` here. One line, English, terse, no markdown, no terminal full stop, and complementing the title rather than repeating it. Lint #34 is what asserts all of that; #1 asserts only the length, because a hero over the cap is truncated by the catalogue page.

artefact.description: §4: one value or a list — an announcement publishing two PDFs has two artefacts and one companion page.

financeRecord.description: A source carrying finance_origin. Applied ON TOP of #/$defs/source, never instead of it.

x-rules.why: finance-record-spec.md → Dates: a finance record with no real event date is not a dated fact. Lint #21 class 1, gated.
facets.md §1 / lint #16: a compiled page must never infer the filing subject from list order, because a sort re-files it invisibly.
finance-record-spec.md → Entities / lint #16: a non-canonical financier key silently fragments a hub Financing aggregate.
Same rule, soft: recipient drift sits below the paging bar and the entity pass reconciles it — route, don't block.

parent.description: The single parent in §1's tree. Empty on XGL alone, which is the root.

entity_type.description: §1's eight values. Blocs (AU, ECOWAS, SADC) are entities, not places.

x-filename.note: §4: {place-slug}--{topic-slug}.md, linked from both the place hub and the concept page.

query.description: operations.md §10. Read-only workspace: a query result is a derived snapshot, never a source.
